parameters.prompt: The exact upright falcon warrior in the reference performs ONE feather-throw in place. Both wings stay folded tightly against its back the whole time and never open. Over the first second it leans back and pulls its right arm far back behind its shoulder. Then it snaps the right arm forward toward screen left in a full throwing motion while thrusting the head forward with the beak open, holds for a brief moment, then returns to the exact original standing pose and holds it. Feet stay planted. Exactly two wings, two arms and two legs. Keep the same three-quarter left view, armour, belt and feathers. No walking, jumping, turning around, flying, second attack, extra limbs or weapon. Fixed camera, fixed size, pure uniform bright green #00FF00 background. The whole character stays inside the frame with wide margins at all times. Do not change any colours or tint. No motion blur, motion trails, afterimages, speed lines, smears, glow, glowing claws, coloured light, energy, liquid, spray, projectiles, feathers flying off, particles, dust, rocks, cracks, shadow or text.
